name: Sniper
ability: Each night*, every player chooses a number from 0 to X. Any player that chose the same number as you, dies. (X = 10 - night + 2)
otherNightReminder: Every player, including the Sniper, wakes and gives a finger signal. :reminder:

jinxes.reason: If the Exorcist chooses the Sniper, all other players still wake to choose a number, and nobody dies tonight.
